newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HCL to market Siemens Nixdorf computers.
newsitem.headline: India's HCL to market Siemens Nixdorf computers.

text.p: Indian software company HCL Frontline Ltd on Wednesday announced a tie-up with Siemens Nixdorf Informations Systems to distribute its latest software products in India, a company statement said.
It said the range of products to be distributed in India included Scenic Pro personal computers, Primergy servers, notebooks and point-of-sale terminals.
"The Scenic Pro PCs and Primergy servers are the latest in the line of desktops and servers," the statement quoted HCL chief executive officer S. Premkumar as saying.
Siemens Nixdorf Informations Systems Ltd is a joint venture between Siemens Nixdorf Informationssysteme AG and India's Siemens Ltd.
HCL Frontline Ltd is a subsidiary of HCL group.
